comments.body:
## RCA (rebar-debug Phase 1 — PROVEN, runtime-confirmed)

**Problem.** The `tickets` branch commit rate jumped ~10x since 2026-08-23; ~88% is the enrichment quartet (ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE_ENRICH + TICKET_DIGEST). 1,239 tickets were re-enriched ~15x each.

**Why a single ticket is re-enriched ~15x (the mechanism).** The digest sidecar is keyed by a content hash over `title + description + comment bodies` (`overlap/digest_sidecar.py::_normalize_text` / `content_hash`, and `freshness` compares stored hash vs current). The drain's self-heal `enrich_drain._stale_digest_ids` (src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py:158) scans **every** ticket dir on **every** drain and returns **every** ticket whose digest is `present-stale`; `_collect_claims` then re-enqueues each with `soak_min=0, now_ns=now-1` (immediately claimable), with **no idempotence, debounce, or per-ticket cap**. So each external content drift (a comment, an edit, or a reconcile writeback) invalidates the digest and produces exactly one full enrich cycle. ~15 drifts/ticket over 8 days ≈ ~2/day of ordinary churn on active tickets — no tight infinite loop, an **unbounded-per-drift** loop.

**Feedback-loop question — answered.** Enrichment's OWN writes do NOT re-stale the digest: `enrich()` (src/rebar/llm/enrich.py) writes no ticket comment; the TICKET_DIGEST sidecar and the ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE queue events are reducer-IGNORED (not in `KNOWN_EVENT_TYPES`), so they never enter compiled `comments`/`description` and are excluded from `content_hash`. There is therefore no self-sustaining enrichment→digest loop. The drift is **external** (comment/edit churn + reconcile writebacks).

**Why the drift became unbounded GROWTH.** Correctness fix `be8a0c0` (Gerrit 989, bug 8185-2d4b-d2bf-4282) removed the only growth bound — `_prune_queue_events` (kept only the newest queue event/ticket) and digest `prune(keep=1)` — deliberately, because physical deletion of committed UUID events breaks the append-only union-merge invariant across stale clones. Before `be8a0c0`, the self-heal still re-fired on drift, but pruning capped the live tree to ~1-2 files/ticket. After it, every re-fire's 4 events are retained forever. Re-firing × removed-pruning = the fan-out.

**Runtime proof (discriminating).** Repro (`repro_fanout.py`, offline `_DigestRunner`): one first-time enrich, then N=12 content drifts each followed by a drain →
```
first-time drain processed=1
drifts=12  re-enrichment cycles=12
ENQUEUE=13 CLAIM=13 DONE=13 DIGEST=13  quartet-total=52
```
12 drifts → 12 re-enrichment cycles (1:1, unbounded) → 13 of each quartet event retained, none pruned. This is the exact production signature (1,239 tickets × ~15 drifts × 4 events ≈ the ~81K quartet events). Discriminates against the "enrichment self-loop" hypothesis (ruled out above) and the "single infinite tight loop" hypothesis (ratio is 1 cycle per external drift, not runaway).

**Defect origin / attribution.** The unbounded *growth* (reported symptom) was introduced by `be8a0c0059571b340cd7705191769a4a64998643d` — `rebar-ticket 8185-2d4b-d2bf-4282` (git blame of the removed `_prune_queue_events`/`prune` is unambiguous; `be8a0c0` is the introducing commit, not a carrier). `be8a0c0` knowingly created the retention problem and deferred the merge-safe replacement to follow-up epic 4520 (apparent-sighted-cockatoo), which was never built. Class = `plan_defect` (the plan removed the sole bound and shipped without a replacement). `caused_by 8185` recorded.

**Legitimacy = defect.** Cited authority: epic 4520 states removing pruning "creates a deliberate long-term retention problem" to be bounded; the downstream disk-fill incident (5a05) is corroborating operational harm. Unbounded store growth violates the store's operational-cost invariant. Re-enriching on genuine drift is legitimate; doing so **without any bound** is the defect.

**Fix (prevention, this ticket).** A per-ticket re-enrichment **debounce** on the self-heal path: skip a present-stale ticket whose latest `DONE_ENRICH` is younger than `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min` (default 24h). Bounds re-firing to ≤1 cycle/ticket/window; deletes no event (preserves the union-merge invariant `be8a0c0` protects). Minimal-yet-sufficient: it stops the fan-out at its multiplier without disabling first-time or post-window enrichment.

Phase 2 implemented — Gerrit change 2386 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2386), commit 10d36bdf0e60, plan-review PASS (signed).

Bound: per-ticket re-enrichment DEBOUNCE on the self-heal path. `enrich_drain._stale_digest_ids` now skips a present-stale ticket whose latest DONE_ENRICH is younger than `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min` (new LLMConfig knob, env `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_REENRICH_DEBOUNCE_MIN`, default 1440 min/24h; 0 disables → pre-fix behavior). `_collect_claims` threads `now` + `debounce_ns`. Deletes NO event → union-merge retention invariant (be8a0c0/epic 4520) preserved. First-time enrichment (no prior DONE_ENRICH) and the cert→enqueue primary path are never debounced. Added an INFO log counting debounced skips (observability, review advisory #3).

Minimal-yet-sufficient: the single fan-out chokepoint is the every-drain stale scan; all drain entrypoints (write-path event_append, push, CLI cmd_enrich, MCP-driven writes) funnel through D.drain→_collect_claims→_stale_digest_ids, so one guard covers every surface (CLI/MCP/reconciler parity confirmed). The `_finalize_claims` drift-during-enrich re-enqueue is a DISTINCT bounded path (fires only on a real edit inside a ticket's own seconds-long enrich window, has no DONE yet) — documented, intentionally not debounced (review advisory #2).

RED→GREEN held-out oracle (tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py): `test_reenrich_debounce_bounds_the_self_heal_fanout` (5 in-window drifts → DONE_ENRICH stays 1; RED pre-fix = 6), plus post-window re-enrich, first-time-never-debounced, and window=0-disables. Mutation-checked under sandbox-exec: disabling the filter flips the oracle RED. Replication: repro harness 12 drifts → 0 re-enrichment cycles / 4 retained events (pre-fix was 12 cycles / 52 events).

Gates: make lint (complexity ratchet new=0/increased=0, module-size OK — config.py held at 799 by compressing adjacent long-landed historical comments in the same DEFAULT block; the file was at the locked 800-LOC cap), make typecheck (clean), full tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py (55 passed). docs/env-vars.md regenerated.

Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before close (caused_by 8185, class plan_defect).

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Since 2026-08-23 the `tickets` event-sourced branch's commit rate jumped ~10x (~1.5-3K/day to 15-23K/day); ~88% of the surge is the enrichment quartet (ENQUEUE_ENRICH / CLAIM_ENRICH / DONE_ENRICH + TICKET_DIGEST). Runtime-proven root cause (this session): the drain self-heal `enrich_drain._stale_digest_ids` re-enqueues **every** ticket whose cached digest is `present-stale` on **every** drain, with `soak_min=0` and no per-ticket rate limit. So ordinary comment/edit/reconcile churn re-enriches a ticket once per content drift (measured: 1,239 tickets ~15x each). Correctness fix `be8a0c0` (bug 8185-2d4b-d2bf-4282) had removed the only growth bound (`_prune_queue_events` + digest `prune(keep=1)`) for a valid union-merge reason, so each re-fire's 4 events are now retained permanently -> unbounded fan-out. Downstream operational impact: /var/gerrit disk-fill (wakeful-ordinary-chicken 5a05). Scope here is PREVENTION only (not history reclamation, which is polite-antivirus-bedbug 536b).

## Approach

Add a per-ticket **re-enrichment debounce** to the self-heal path only. `_stale_digest_ids` skips a present-stale ticket whose most recent enrichment (latest `DONE_ENRICH` event timestamp) is younger than a configurable window `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min` (default 1440 min = 24h). A slightly-stale dedup digest is an acceptable overlap hint until the window elapses; the next drain after it elapses re-enriches, so digests stay eventually-fresh. This bounds re-firing to at most one cycle per ticket per window regardless of drift volume, and it deletes **no** committed event, so it preserves the append-only union-merge invariant that 8185/4520 require (physical deletion is explicitly disallowed). First-time enrichment (no prior `DONE_ENRICH`), the certification->enqueue primary path, and explicit re-certification are all untouched (they do not pass through the self-heal). Default 1440 assumes a day of digest staleness is acceptable for dedup; operators tune via the env knob.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/config.py` - add `DEFAULT_OVERLAP_REENRICH_DEBOUNCE_MIN = 1440`, `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min: int` field, and the `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_REENRICH_DEBOUNCE_MIN` read in `from_env` (mirrors `overlap_soak_min`).
- `src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py` - `_stale_digest_ids` gains a debounce filter keyed on the latest `DONE_ENRICH` timestamp (`queue._latest(dir, DONE)`); `_collect_claims` passes `now` and the window (ns). A `debounce=0` value disables the filter (pre-fix behavior).
- `tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py` - RED->GREEN debounce unit tests.
- `docs/env-vars.md` - regenerated via `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py` (CI drift gate).

## Testing

- Happy path (the bound): a ticket enriched once, then drifting N times within the window, produces 0 additional re-enrichment cycles (was N) and its `DONE_ENRICH` count stays 1.
- Boundary: a present-stale ticket whose last enrichment predates the window IS re-enriched (drain `now` driven past the window) -> digest becomes `present-fresh`.
- First-time: a ticket with no prior `DONE_ENRICH` is never debounced (processed on first drain).
- Disabled: `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min = 0` restores the exact pre-fix behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `_stale_digest_ids` skips a present-stale ticket whose latest `DONE_ENRICH` is within `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min`; verified by a unit test asserting N in-window drifts produce 0 re-enrichment cycles (test seen RED before the change).
- [ ] A present-stale ticket whose last enrichment predates the window IS re-enriched; verified by a unit test that drives drain `now` past the window and asserts the digest becomes `present-fresh`.
- [ ] First-time enrichment is unaffected: a ticket with no prior `DONE_ENRICH` is never debounced; verified by a unit test.
- [ ] `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min` is a config knob (default + dataclass field + env read) reachable via `LLMConfig.from_env`, and `docs/env-vars.md` is regenerated so the CI drift gate is green.
- [ ] No committed UUID event is deleted or renamed by the change (the union-merge invariant from 8185/4520 is preserved); verified by inspection and by the existing two-clone `test_concurrency_regression` staying green.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and targeted `pytest tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py` pass.

file_impact.reason: Add a per-ticket re-enrichment debounce to the self-heal path (_stale_digest_ids skips a present-stale ticket whose latest DONE_ENRICH is within the window); _collect_claims threads now + the window.
New overlap_reenrich_debounce_min knob: DEFAULT constant, dataclass field, and REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_REENRICH_DEBOUNCE_MIN read in from_env.
RED->GREEN unit tests: N in-window drifts -> 0 re-enrichment cycles; post-window re-enrichment; first-time never debounced; debounce=0 disables.
